title: Google Search Console and Bing verification
summary: Add the domain to Search Console, verify it with a DNS TXT record, and import it into Bing.
why: Needed to monitor how the site is indexed in Google and Bing, submit a sitemap and see errors (RULES.md Section 10.11).
prerequisites: Access to the domain's DNS settings (Hostinger hPanel → **Domains → DNS / Nameservers**).

steps.title: Add the given TXT record to DNS
steps.detail: hPanel → **Domains → DNS / Nameservers → Add record**: Type **TXT**, Name `@`, Value: the `google-site-verification=…` string Google gives you. Propagation can take a few minutes to a few hours.

steps.title: Import into Bing Webmaster Tools from Search Console
steps.detail: Use **Import from Google Search Console** to add it in one click.

fields.label: The domain is **verified** in Search Console
